subtitle: Shaya izinombolo eziphindwayo
short_description: Shaya izinombolo eziphindiwe ngaphandle kokuhlukanisa ibhodi.
description:
Shaya amaseli ukuze inombolo ingavele ngaphezu kwesisodwa emugqeni noma kukholomu phakathi kwamaseli angakashayiwe. Amaseli ashayiwe angeke athinte ngomphetho, futhi wonke amaseli angakashayiwe kumelwe ahlale eyiqembu elilodwa elixhunyiwe.

Thepha iseli elinenombolo ukuze ujikeleze phakathi kokushaya, isikhumbuzo, nokungashayiwe.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
